name: Push a loaded cart for fifty metres
short_description: Push a loaded cart for fifty metres once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can push a loaded cart for fifty metres in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Push a loaded cart for fifty metres means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Push a loaded cart for fifty metres in a fresh real-life scenario.
